text:
oscar: noticing sporadic GPU allocation failures in eu-west1: some tenants getting spindown errors when warmpool prefill runs. saw a cluster of 5 failures at 1850000000.
infra-bot: ALERT prefill_failures eu-west1.warmpool > 3 in 1m. pods: prefill-45, prefill-46.
lina: logs show vm image pull delay + late NIC attach timeouts. might be rack-level network flakiness. chang: any thermal events in that rack?
chang: racks 12-13 reported elevated retry counts, but no thermal alarms. NIC counters show RX overruns. suspect short-lived RX buffer exhaustion during bursty prefill.
oscar: could that be noisy neighbor from dedicated slice buildouts? we recently scheduled a big dedicated capacity rebalancer job.
lina: yes, rebalancer started at 1849999950 targeting eu-west1. it was aggressive on parallelism. recommendation: throttle rebalancer concurrency to 4 per AZ.
chang: also propose we add a prefill backoff jitter and stagger node attachment times to avoid NIC storms.
oscar: agree. implement throttle now?
lina: applying rebalancer throttle at 1850000020. will update when we see effect.
infra-bot: action recorded: scaled rebalancer concurrency -> 4 by lina at 1850000021.
chang: after throttle, seeing fewer attach timeouts. prefill failures dropped to 0 in the last 30s.
oscar: good. follow-ups: 1) add rebalancer concurrency guard in config 2) add eBPF probe to flag RX buffer exhaustion before node attach 3) ticket infra-8120 to investigate NIC driver tuning for burst scenarios.
lina: I'll PR the guard and file infra-8120.
oscar: thanks. will keep monitoring for any collateral impact to dedicated fallback routes.
